gcs.description: Original published 16-second TORO teaser and poster; copied unchanged

piper.description: Project-owned continuous four-transfer run. GIF transcoded to muted H.264; same frames and 4x playback.

hopper.description: Project-owned outdoor trial, source interval 2–10 seconds at 1x. Cropped source GIF transcoded to H.264, with one bottom padding pixel for even dimensions. Nearby operator is visible. Full recording, including recovery, remains linked from the repository.

kaist_humanoid.description: Official KAIST DRCD Lab v0.7 field-test demo, embedded from YouTube with preview interval 20–34 seconds. The existing KAIST lab-platform photograph is used as a poster.

marvel.description: Existing adaptive-foot and robot-experiment photographs retained.

design.description: Original implementation following the reference’s light academic layout, serif heading, rounded navigation, 2-column highlights and compact research rows.

about.source: Existing portfolio CV section and public GitHub profile
about.description: Education and DLR experience retained from the existing site. No CV PDF was present; CV opens the on-page background section.

marvel_climbing_video.description: Official DRCD Lab video for Agile and versatile climbing on ferromagnetic surfaces with a quadrupedal robot (Science Robotics, 2022). YouTube preview interval 10–26 seconds. Labelled as a lab demonstration, distinct from the author’s adaptive MME-DAM foot experiment.

hopper_indoor.description: Recorded indoor trial with a rolling test frame and nearby operators. Original 20–30 second interval, 1× speed, muted H.264 at 640-pixel width. Poster extracted at preview time 3 seconds.
